1.1: Megilla nikret beachad asar, bishnem asar, bishlosha asar, bearbaa asar, bachamishsha asar, lo fachot velo yoter. kerakkin hammukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, korin bachamishsha asar. kefarim vaayarot gedolot, korin bearbaa asar, ella shehakkefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa:
1.2: Ketzad. chal lihyot yom arbaa asar bashsheni, kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot bashshelishi o barvii, kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot bachamishi, kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot erev shabbat, kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayarot gedolot umukkafot choma korin bo vayyom. chal lihyot beshabbat, kefarim vaayarot gedolot makdimin vekorin leyom hakkenisa, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot achar hashshabbat, kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar:
1.3: Ezo hi ir gedola, kol sheyyesh bah asara vatlanim. pachot mikkan, hare ze chefar. baellu amru makdimin velo meacharin. aval zeman atze chohanim vetisha veav, chagiga vehakehel, meacharin velo makdimin. af al pi sheamru makdimin velo meacharin, muttarin behesped uvetaaniyyot umattanot laevyonim. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, mekom shennichnasin besheni uvachamishi. aval mekom sheen nichnasin lo besheni velo vachamishi, en korin otah ella vizmannah:
1.4: Karu et hammegilla baadar harishon venitabbera hashshana, korin otah baadar hashsheni, en ben adar harishon laadar hashsheni ella keriat hammegilla umattanot laevyonim:
1.5: En ben yom tov leshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. en ben shabbat leyom hakkippurim ella shezze zedono bide adam veze zedono becharet:
1.6: En ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar mimmennu maachol ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. en ben nedarim lindavot ella shehannedarim chayyav beacharayutan, unedavot eno chayyav beacharayutan:
1.7: En ben zav haroe shete reiyyot leroe shalosh ella karban. en ben metzora musgar limtzora muchlat ella feria uferima. en ben tahor mittoch hesger letahor mittoch hechlet ella tiglachat vetzipporim:
1.8: En ben sefarim litfillin umezuzot ella shehassefarim nichtavin bechol lashon, utefillin umezuzot enan nichtavot ella ashshurit. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af bassefarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevanit:
1.9: En ben kohen mashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe vegadim ella par habba al kol hammitzvot. en ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa:
1.10: En ben bama gedola levama ketanna ella fesachim. ze hakkelal, kol shehu niddar veniddav, karev babbama. vechol sheeno lo niddar velo niddav, eno karev babbama:
1.11: En ben shilo lirushalayim ella shebbeshilo ochlim kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe, uvirushalayim lifnim min hachoma. vechan vechan kadshe kadashim neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kedushshat shilo yesh achareha hetter, ukedushshat yerushalayim en achareha hetter:

2.1: Hakkore et hammegilla lemafrea, lo yatza. keraah al pe, keraah targum, bechol lashon, lo yatza. aval korin otah lalloazot belaaz. vehalloez sheshshama ashshurit, yatza:
2.2: Keraah serugin, umitnamnem, yatza. haya chotvah, dorshah, umaggihah, im kivven libbo, yatza. veim lav, lo yatza. hayta ketuva besam, uvesikra, uvekomos uvekankantom, al hanneyar veal haddiftera, lo yatza, ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit, al hassefer uvidyo:
2.3: Ben ir shehalach lichrach uven kerach shehalach leir, im atid lachazor limkomo, kore chimkomo. veim lav, kore immahen. umehechan kore adam et hammegilla veyotze bah yede chovato, rabbi meir omer, kullah. rabbi yehuda omer, meish yehudi (Ester b 5). rabbi yose omer, meachar haddevarim haelle (Ester 3:1):
2.4: Hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh, shote, vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan. en korin et hammegilla, velo malin, velo tovlin, velo mazzin, vechen shomeret yom keneged yom lo titbol, ad shettanetz hachamma. vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar, kasher:
2.5: Kol hayyom kasher likriat hammegilla, velikriat hahallel, velitkiat shofar, velintilat lulav, velitfillat hammusafin, velammusafin, ulevidduy happarim, ulevidduy hammaaser, ulevidduy yom hakkippurim, lassemicha, lashshechita, lattenufa, lahaggasha, lakkemitza velahaktara, lammelika, velakkabbala, velahazzaya, ulehashkayat sota, velaarifat haegla, uletaharat hammetzora:
2.6: Kol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer ulehekter chalavim veevarim. ze hakkelal, davar shemmitzvato vayyom, kasher kol hayyom. davar shemmitzvato vallayla, kasher kol hallayla:

3.1: Bene hair shemmachru rechovah shel ir, lokchin bedamav bet hakkeneset. bet hakkeneset, lokchin teva. teva, lokchin mitpachot. mitpachot, lokchin sefarim. sefarim, lokchin tora. aval im machru tora, lo yikchu sefarim. sefarim, lo yikchu mitpachot. mitpachot, lo yikchu teva. teva, lo yikchu vet hakkeneset. bet hakkeneset, lo yikchu et harchov. vechen bemotrehen. en mochrin et shel rabbim leyachid, mippene shemmoridin oto mikkedushshato, divre rabbi yehuda. amru lo, im ken, af lo meir gedola leir ketanna:
3.2: En mochrin bet hakkeneset, ella al tenay sheim yirtzu yachaziruhu, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, mochrim oto mimkar olam, chutz mearbaa devarim, lemerchatz ulevurseki velitvila ulevet hammayim. rabbi yehuda omer, mochrin oto leshem chatzer, vehallokeach ma sheyyirtze yaase:
3.3: Veod amar rabbi yehuda, bet hakkeneset shecharav, en maspidin betocho, veen mafshilin betocho chavalim, veen porsin letocho metzudot, veen shotchin al gaggo ferot, veen osin oto kappandarya, shenneemar (Vayikra 26), vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem, kedushshatan af keshehen shomemin. alu vo asavim, lo yitlosh, mippene agmat nafesh:
3.4: Rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat, korin befarashat shekalim (Shemot 30). chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat, makdimin lesheavar umafsikin leshabbat acheret. bashsheniyya, zachor (Devarim 25). bashshelishit, para adumma (Bamidbar 19:2). barviit, hachodesh hazze lachem (Shemot 12). bachamishit, chozrin lichsidran. lakkol mafsikin, berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim, battaaniyyot uvammaamadot uveyom hakkippurim:
3.5: Befesach korin befarashat moadot shel torat kohanim (Vayikra 22). baatzeret, shiva shavuot (Devarim 16). berosh hashshana, bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh (Vayikra 23). beyom hakkippurim, achare mot (sham 16). beyom tov harishon shel chag korin befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim (Vayikra 23), uvishar kol yemot hechag bekarbenot hechag (Bamidbar 29):
3.6: Bachanukka, bannesiim (sham 7). befurim, vayyavo amalek (Shemot 17). berashe chodashim, uverashe chadshechem (Bamidbar 28). bammaamadot, bemaase bereshit (Bereshit 1). battaaniyyot, berachot ukelalot (Vayikra 26). en mafsikin bakkelalot, ella echad kore et kullan. bashsheni uvachamishi uveshabbat bammincha, korin kesidran, veen olin lahem min hacheshbon, shenneemar (Vayikra 23), vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael, mitzvatan sheyyehu korin kol echad veechad bizmanno:

4.1: Hakkore et hammegilla omed veyoshev. keraah echad, kerauha shenayim, yatzu. mekom shennahagu levarech, yevarech. veshello levarech, lo yevarech. besheni uvachamishi uveshabbat bammincha, korin shelosha, en pochatin veen mosifin alehen, veen maftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora, mevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
4.2: Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed, korin arbaa, en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen, veen maftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora, mevarech lefaneha uleachareha. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyesh bo musaf veeno yom tov, korin arbaa. beyom tov, chamishsha. beyom hakkippurim, shishsha. beshabbat, shiva. en pochatin mehen, aval mosifin alehen, umaftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora, mevarech lefaneha uleachareha:
4.3: En porsin et shema, veen ovrin lifne hatteva, veen nosin et kappehem, veen korin battora, veen maftirin bannavi, veen osin maamad umoshav, veen omrim birkat avelim vetanchume avelim uvirkat chatanim, veen mezammenin bashshem, pachot measara. uvakkarkaot, tisha vechohen. veadam, kayyotze bahen:
4.4: Hakkore battora lo yifchot mishshelosha fesukim. lo yikra lammeturgeman yoter mippasuk echad, uvannavi shelosha. hayu shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot, korin echad echad. medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora. vead kamma hu medalleg, ad kede shello yifsok hammeturgeman:
4.5: Hammaftir bannavi, hu pores al shema, vehu over lifne hatteva, vehu nose et kappav. veim haya katan, aviv o rabbo ovrin al yado:
4.6: Katan kore battora umetargem, aval eno pores al shema, veeno over lifne hatteva, veeno nose et kappav. pocheach pores et shema umetargem, aval eno kore vattora veeno over lifne hatteva veeno nose et kappav. suma pores et shema umetargem. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shello raa meorot miyyamav, eno pores al shema:
4.7: Kohen sheyyesh beyadav mumin, lo yissa et kappav. rabbi yehuda omer, af mi shehayu yadav tzevuot istis ufua, lo yissa et kappav, mippene shehaam mistakkelin bo:
4.8: Haomer eni over lifne hatteva vitzvuin, af bilvanim lo yaavor. besandal eni over, af yachef lo yaavor. haose tefillato agulla, sakkana veen bah mitzva. netanah al mitzcho o al pas yado, hare zo derech hamminut. tzippan zahav, unetanah al bet unkeli shello, hare zo derech hachitzonim:
4.9: Haomer yevarchucha tovim, hare zo derech hamminut. al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha, veal tov yizzacher shemecha, modim modim, meshattekin oto. hamechanne vaarayot, meshattekin oto. haomer, umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech (Vayikra 18), umizarach lo titten leabara bearmayuta, meshattekin oto vinzifa:
4.10: Maase reuven (Bereshit la), nikra velo mittargem. maase tamar (Bereshit lach), nikra umittargem. maase egel harishon (Shemot 32), nikra umittargem. vehashsheni (sham), nikra velo mittargem. birkat kohanim (Bamidbar 6), maase david (Shmuel b 11:27) veamnon (Shmuel b 13), lo nikrain velo mittargemin. en maftirin bammerkava (yechezkel 1), verabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi eliezer omer, en maftirin behoda et yerushalayim (yechezkel 16:2):
